name: Homunculus Servant
hit_points_formula: 5 + 5 per spell level (the homunculus has a number of Hit Dice [d4s] equal to the spell's level)

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: Reference-only rule. See Eberron: Forge of the Artificer, page 21.

traits.name: Magic Bond
traits.description: Add the summoning spell level to the homunculus’s ability checks and saving throws.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.description: Melee or ranged spell attack; on a hit, deal 1d6 + the summoning spell level Force damage.

reactions.name: Channel Magic
reactions.description: Deliver the summoner’s touch-range spell while within 120 feet.

description: Reference stat block from Eberron: Forge of the Artificer, page 21.
